programme: Finish open work → push Matrix → image SEO → title/meta → content upgrade → technical SEO; QA → merge → deploy → live verification → Matrix sync
resume_rule: On 'tiếp tục': read docs/seo-matrix/CHECKPOINT.json and TASKS.json on main, check the current task's branch/PR/CI/deploy, finish it, then take next_todo. Never redo LIVE_VERIFIED tasks.
next_action: Re-run the audit pipeline (collect → analyze → ledger → az_matrix → workbook) and docs/seo-audit/tools/tech_reaudit.py on current main; add a task to TASKS.json only for a verified new finding on an existing URL; otherwise monitor (indexing and rankings stay unmeasured without Search Console)

standards.image_bytes: 100–300 KB per main image (smaller accepted when sharp; responsive variants are smaller by design; over 300 KB must be re-encoded or justified)
standards.title: fits ~600 px (≈50–65 Latin characters, ≈30 CJK characters); short titles reviewed, never padded
